# Thermoprops

> Free web app for the thermodynamic properties of fluids and refrigerants, computed with CoolProp's equations of state (not interpolated from tables): saturation and superheated tables, p–h and T–s diagrams, a State Explorer, and a Worksheet that solves whole cycles. In English and Spanish.

A Worksheet's script lives in its address: a link opens it solved, in the reader's browser. The same script, sent to the API, comes back solved as JSON.

## Compute

- [Calculation API](https://thermoprops-api.luisbedoia.workers.dev/): `GET /solve?s=<script>` answers JSON with every state, its properties, the computed values and a link to the Worksheet. Free, no key. This address is its manual, as plain text.
- [MCP server](https://thermoprops-api.luisbedoia.workers.dev/mcp): the same as MCP tools, `fluid_state` (a state from two properties) and `solve_worksheet` (a whole script). Streamable HTTP, no authentication.
- [Link to a calculation](https://luisbedoia.github.io/thermoprops/links/): the script language, the link format, the 30 fluids and worked examples.
- [Worksheet](https://luisbedoia.github.io/thermoprops/worksheet/): states, processes and cycles, written as in a notebook.
- [State Explorer](https://luisbedoia.github.io/thermoprops/explorer/): a fluid's states from any two properties, on its diagrams.
